row.notes: F1Aero data vtable 0x145bfc370 slot 2 (Read). Reads every F1Aero key by name with Game_Read_VtfFloat / Car_Assets_FindSpline / Car_Assets_FindUInt and stores CarObfFloat pairs at data offset X (= system offset X+0x18, structs/CarF1Aero.h): BodyDragCoeffMin (alias m_aero_cd_min) data+0x1710, BodyDragCoeffMax +0x1720, front/rear cl maps +0x10..+0x40/+0x120..+0x150, ride-height clamps +0x90..+0xc0, slipstream scales +0xd0..+0x110, m_aero_wing_* +0x170..+0x1a0, 8 splines (0x2a8 each) from +0x1b0, Front/RearCoeffLiftMultiplier +0x16f0/+0x1700, wing CoL/CoD +0x1740..+0x1800, damage mults +0x1810/+0x1820, DRS +0x1830..+0x1870, drag offsets/coeffs +0x1890..+0x18c0, brake duct/radiator +0x18d0..+0x1930, AdjustableFrontWing bool +0x1940. Missing keys keep the current value; Upgrade blocks replay through the same reader with op scaling (Game_Read_VtfFloat).
